outstandingUniversalValue.summary: Sun Temple at Konârak is an outstanding example of temple architecture and art, representing the 13th-century kingdom of Orissa and the monumental personification of Surya.

architecturalSignificance.statement: The temple is an outstanding example of temple architecture and art in conception, scale, proportion and sculptural expression.

historicalSignificance.statement: Konârak is an outstanding testimony to the 13th-century kingdom of Orissa.

religiousAndCulturalSignificance.statement: The property is directly and materially linked to the diffusion of the cult of Surya and to Brahmanical and tantric belief systems.

artisticSignificance.statement: The monument contains sophisticated sculptural and iconographical representations connected with religious, political, social and secular life.

unescoCriteria.title: Masterpiece of human creative genius
